description:
A gameplay-first, balance-friendly, fully-configurable skill overhaul.

^Click the banner, it's waiting for you. Supports LunaLib ingame configuation.

Perks only? I gotchu. For use with SIC and other replacers. Do not use both Captains and Perks at the same time. Captains includes the perks.

Highlights:
A thorough overhaul of every skill, based on hundreds of hours of gameplay in 0.91 and 0.95 with additions from the latest features.
Multiple skill trees to choose between, including all skills available at the start (examples from 0.95 version)
The restoration of beloved skill effects, such 1%-flux speed boost
Restores combat texture that recent patches have replaced with +/- damage - Feel your fleet builds again!
Removed fleet size penalities and multiple new dynamic limits to chose from.
A complete ECM and NAV overhaul
Over 10 perks with significant QOL effects!
Fully customizable, down to the individual effect!
A growing number of easter eggs

discordPostHtml:
A gameplay-first, balance friendly, completely configurable skill overhaul.
QC brings QOL features, meaningful choices, and more than 300 options to tweak the game to perfection.
Every skill has been carefully curated for the the best features from every game version. Most skills are more flexible than before, designed to benefit every ship and excel on specialized craft.

  • Every skill is balanced against all the others and the choices you make will be based on how you want to play.
  • Skills don't change their power based on your fleet size
  • Also makes ECM and Navigation battle effects way more fun.

V1.5 introduced a perk system with milestones that your character automatically unlocks as they progress through the story. These milestones include powerful QOL features and most of the effects are completely fresh to the modiverse.

V1.6 incorporates a few of the latest skill effects in 0.97, but the best part is none of the +/- raw damage effects are included. Enjoy Starsector at its best, with the full texture of the game.

**Enjoy! Download is below ** or through the thread.

Direct DL: https://github.com/Dal-041/QualityCaptains/releases/latest/download/Quality.Captains.zip
Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=21038.0
aiDescription: Overhauls every skill with multiple configurable trees and adds milestones. Restores beloved skill effects and removes fleet size penalties. Fully customizable down to individual effects.
saveCompatibilityText: Quality Captains can be installed in previous save, though it may be a good idea to head to your storage before making the switch.
removalCompatibilityText: As of 1.5.0 the answer is "untested but probably not easily." There is an uninstallation-mode toggle available in the mod's settings that removes scripts but player perks may need manual editing.
